basic_info.description: 720 Ashbury is a six unit Mid-Century apartment building excellently located in the Haight Ashbury district of San Francisco. The property includes 6 one bedroom/one bath apartments and 6 parking spaces. There is a common area coin operated laundry with one washer and one dryer for tenant use. There is ample space for tenants to park their bicycles. Units are separately metered for gas and electricity. Separate heat. Owner pays for water and garbage. Soft Story Seismic Retrofit completed in 2017. Situated only a block from the legendary intersection of Haight & Ashbury Streets, residents have easy access to The Panhandle, Golden Gate Park, and Buena Vista Park,  offering a seamless blend of urban living and outdoor recreation. Public transportation is abundant, with MUNI bus lines, BART, and freeway entrances nearby.
